item.title: Ghalibaf's reacts to IRGC's achievement against the US: A knockout!
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf posted an image on his X account, sarcastically noting that the United States' most advanced smart Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) had been caught off guard and captured by the IRGC Navy.

item.title: Iran deems new UK sanctions illegal and contrary to shared interests of two countries
item.description: London, IRNA – Expressing deep regret over the British government's decision to impose fresh sanctions on the Iranian people, the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in London condemned the move as illegal and contrary to the two nations' shared interests, warning that London's alignment with the US policy of economic terrorism would further heighten the wall of mistrust between the two countries.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86258974/Iran-deems-new-UK-sanctions-illegal-and-contrary-to-shared-interests

London, IRNA – Expressing deep regret over the British government's decision to impose fresh sanctions on the Iranian people, the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in London condemned the move as illegal and contrary to the two nations' shared interests, warning that London's alignment with the US policy of economic terrorism would further heighten the wall of mistrust between the two countries.

item.title: Araghchi: US waged war on Iran on Israel’s behalf
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi mocked US policy towards Iran, saying Washington waged war on Tehran on behalf of Israel and resorted to further sanctions after both military action and sanctions failed to achieve their goals.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86258967/Araghchi-US-waged-war-on-Iran-on-Israel-s-behalf
